summary: Verified the MapView.jsx compile/syntax fix. Owner login succeeds, SPA navigates to /map, [data-testid=map-container] renders, 'Property Acquisition' panel visible. No SyntaxError, no 'Unexpected token', no 'initMapLayers is not defined' in page errors or console. Only 403 axios errors surface from /api/map-config due to suspended org subscription (expected paywall behavior per request).

integration_issues.issue: AxiosError 403 on /api/map-config surfaces via React runtime error overlay in dev build. Expected due to suspended subscription — not a regression, but the errors should ideally be caught to prevent the red overlay from covering the UI in dev mode.

critical_code_review_comments: MapView.jsx at /app is 863 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting territory/property/drawing/route/clustering into hooks or sub-modules.

Axios 403 responses inside the map init effect propagate as uncaught promise rejections producing the React dev error overlay. Wrap the map bootstrap in try/catch and show a friendly paywall banner instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 confirmed the one-line syntax fix (const initMapLayers = () => { ... }) at MapView.jsx ~line 252 is working. Build parses, /map route renders map-container and Property Acquisition panel. The visible 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay in screenshots is React dev overlay from expected 403s (suspended subscription) — not a MapView regression.
